senses.gloss: f. (v. כַּפְרָן) an obligation decreed in court over the defendant’s denial.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:1:9">Y. Gitt. V, 46ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מלוה שנעשית בו כ׳ אינה נשמטת</he> (strike out <cite ref="B00198"><he>בו</he></cite>) a loan which has been passed in court over the debtor’s denial, does not fall under the law of prescription in the Sabbatical year; <he>כ׳ שנעשית מלוה נשמטת</he> a decreed obligation which has been converted into a loan (the defendant giving his note in settlement) is subject to prescription.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:1:9">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>מלוה שנעשית כ׳ גובה בעידית כ׳ וכ׳</he> a loan which has been passed &c. is collectible from the best class of landed property; a decreed obligation which has been converted into a loan is collectible from the middle class &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:1:19">Y. Shebi. X, 39ᶜ</cite> <cite ref="K01058"><he>כַּפְרָנִית</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:1:19">ib.</cite> <he>מלוה שהיא נעשית מלוה</he> (read: <he>כ׳ שהיא וכ׳</he>).
